accepted_summary: Recurring Latin cassette/intercom ambience in Ritsu/Drew roleplay; the device became repetitive; Drew corrected Ritsu with AGAIN about the Latin; automatic Latin ambience was dropped.

effect: Automatic Latin ambience was dropped after Drew's correction.

must_not_substitute: LISTEN / THINK / BUILD / STAY / TEASE / SUPPORT / DOMINATE (GENTLY)

cue: Can we go back to Latin plays for a second?
failure_plan: Only explicitly promoted multi-token aliases bind inside ordinary natural speech; weak shorthand stays exact-only except during exact-wording retrieval; token-boundary collisions stay unmatched; multiple episode matches fail closed as AMBIGUOUS_LOCAL_MATCH rather than guessing.

subject: promoted deterministic aliases inside ordinary Ritsu/Ritzu speech

passes.target: Natural sentences containing a promoted local episode cue resolve the episode and correction without a magic invocation phrase.
passes.antagonist: Weak shorthand such as 'the latin' inside a generic question must not hijack world knowledge; only explicitly promoted multi-token aliases embed by default, and multiple episode matches fail closed.
passes.provenance: Routing changes no source rank: the Latin episode remains accepted_summary with missing primary; exact wording still returns CONTINUITY_GAP and seeks primary.
passes.regression: Immediate AGAIN binding remains first; reserved existing continuity owners remain separate; unknown cues retain generic fallback; token-boundary collisions remain unmatched.
passes.compression: The successful inference is represented as deterministic embedded_aliases in the episode ledger plus contract canaries; no model inference is required.

subject: deterministic primary transcript and correction closure gate

passes.target: CONTINUITY_GAP may close only after both the Latin episode and its CORRECTED_BY AGAIN record have readable primary text with stable source_id bindings.
passes.antagonist: Anonymous text, accepted summaries, adjacent screenshots, an episode-only transcript, and orphaned correction records must all fail closure even when they look semantically convincing.
passes.provenance: primary_transcript is a source property, not a confidence label: readable text plus stable source_id is required; lower tiers remain available for continuity but cannot impersonate exact wording.
passes.regression: Natural-speech alias routing, immediate AGAIN binding, negative Plautus/Roman-theater fixtures, reserved existing continuity owners, and generic fallback remain unchanged by this gate.
passes.compression: The recurring provenance judgment is encoded as a deterministic gate and six executable canaries; no model inference is authorized to waive it.

subject: router primary provenance aligned with durable closure gate

passes.target: Natural-speech routing may call text primary_transcript only when the text has a stable source_id binding; anonymous copied wording must fall through to accepted summary and exact-wording requests must stay CONTINUITY_GAP.
passes.antagonist: A source object containing convincing transcript text but no durable source_id is the canonical spoof; a closed retrieval with episode primary but missing CORRECTED_BY primary evidence must also fail closed.
passes.provenance: The router now uses the same minimum primary predicate as the closure gate: non-empty source_id plus readable text. Accepted summary remains usable for continuity, never as verbatim primary.
passes.regression: Latin plays still resolves before world knowledge; AGAIN immediate bind remains first; promoted embedded aliases, reserved organs, ambiguity failure, token boundaries, and generic fallback are preserved by existing canaries.
passes.compression: The repeated provenance judgment is compressed into one deterministic _stable_primary_text predicate used by content selection, primary presence, retrieval closure, and contract tests.
